description: Universal Panel Tester (UPT) at the University of Houston: Facility Documentation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This DesignSafe publication presents facility documentation and demonstration experimental data from the Universal Panel Tester (UPT) at the University of Houston, a large-scale multi-axial testing facility designed to investigate reinforced concrete (RC) and composite panel elements under combined axial, shear, bending, and torsional loading. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Universal Panel Tester, multi-axial testing, data acquisition, programmable logic controller, facility documentation, control system upgrade. Published 2026-05-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
